newsitem.title: USA: Labor Ready says CFO Russell resigns.
newsitem.headline: Labor Ready says CFO Russell resigns.

text.p: Labor Ready Inc on Thursday Chief Financial Officer Charles Russell has resigned for personal reasons, and the company has begun a search for a replacement.
Russell joined Labor Ready in November from Boston-based Daka International, and he has elected to return to the East Coast to pursue his career, Labor Ready said in a statement.
While the company searches for a replacement, Chief Operating Officer Ralph Peterson will assume the duties of chief financial officer. Peterson was the company's previous executive at that position.
